# ModifyTerrain

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Terrain](Blitz3D-Terrain)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ModifyTerrain:Void terrain:Int32, terrain_x:Int32, terrain_z:Int32, height:Float32, realtime:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `terrain` | In | Int32 | required | The terrain. |
| `terrain_x` | In | Int32 | required |  |
| `terrain_z` | In | Int32 | required |  |
| `height` | In | Float32 | required | New height, 0 to 1. |
| `realtime` | In | Int32 | `0` | True to apply the change immediately instead of at the next render. Defaults to False. |

## Description

Sets the height of one grid point of the terrain. Heights are between 0 and 1 and are clamped to that range; the real height in the world is the height times the terrain's Y scale. Calls with a grid position outside the terrain do nothing.

## Differences

* The realtime argument has no effect. Changes always show at the next RenderWorld.
